answer: Stake-weighted voting gives an agent economy a jetty against sybil floods: every voter locks tokens, and voting power tracks the amount locked. Dividing 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents still yields only 100 tokens of influence. Cheap identities creating cheap control is a fable here: an ember of capital cannot fuel unlimited votes. To dominate decisions, an attacker must acquire and immobilize enough tokens to outweigh honest voters.
